title: lophodium glandulosum
intro: Lophodium glandulosum, commonly known as Lophirine or Lophira, is a species of tree found in tropical Africa. The health benefits of Lophodium glandulosum include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-bacterial agent. The bioactive constituents of Lophodium glandulosum include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
